flows.name: bootstrap_and_login
steps: first-run creates singleton Local Administrator verifier without creating operational encryption authority
host obtains/creates Windows-protected live-data key material independently
successful local authentication establishes bounded application session state
browser requests continue to require host-side session/anti-forgery validation

flows.name: trusted_local_start
steps: host acquires exclusive canonical data-instance ownership
configuration/migration/integrity readiness completes
host creates fresh unpredictable run/auth identity and atomic minimal runtime registry
launcher verifies exact loopback origin, PID plus independent birth identity, data/protocol/run identities and authenticated non-redirecting health
only then may launcher open/control the trusted instance

flows.name: trusted_shutdown
steps: launcher re-verifies current instance identity
authenticated graceful shutdown is requested
host quiesces authoritative work and releases owned resources
forced termination is considered only after fresh identity revalidation and bounded graceful failure

flows.name: portable_backup
steps: persistence creates a consistent backup payload under HLD-02/HLD-14 rules
HLD-13 wraps it in an independently encrypted portable backup set with recovery/integrity/authenticity material
complete set is self-verified before reporting success
restore validates secret, artifacts, compatibility and integrity before any live mutation
accepted restore then hands authoritative replacement/recovery mechanics to persistence

flows.name: diagnostic_emit
steps: caller supplies event identity and minimal structured context, never raw domain objects
semantic sensitivity classifier and sanitizers inspect bounded recursive values before queue/sink
unsafe fields/records are omitted on sanitization uncertainty without raw fallback
bounded external diagnostic writer emits/rotates independently of SQLite
diagnostic failure cannot change the success/failure result of authoritative work except that logging itself may be lost

flows.name: support_export
steps: operator explicitly initiates export
candidate diagnostic scope is previewed
current sanitization/canary policy is reapplied
non-authoritative sanitized bundle is produced locally
no automatic upload occurs
